prompt.en: What does Discover Canada say about languages other than English and French in Canada?
prompt.fr: Que dit Découvrir le Canada des langues autres que l'anglais et le français au Canada?

options.en: It is against the law to speak them in public.
options.fr: La loi interdit de les parler en public.

options.en: Hardly anyone in Canada speaks them any more.
options.fr: Presque plus personne ne les parle au Canada.

options.en: They are recognized as official languages in every province and territory.
options.fr: Elles sont reconnues comme langues officielles dans toutes les provinces et tous les territoires.

options.en: Many Canadians speak them at home, alongside English and French.
options.fr: Beaucoup de Canadiens les parlent à la maison, en plus de l'anglais et du français.

explanation.en: English and French are Canada's two official languages. Many other languages are also spoken in Canadian homes.
explanation.fr: L'anglais et le français sont les deux langues officielles du Canada. Beaucoup d'autres langues se parlent aussi dans les foyers canadiens.

source.quote: Non-official languages are widely spoken in Canadian homes.

verification.evidence: English and French define the reality of day-to-day life for most people and are the country’s official languages. … New Brunswick is the only officially bilingual province. … Non-official languages are widely spoken in Canadian homes.
